item.title: Shell And Landers Partner To Give Motorists More Ways To Save
item.description: Shell Pilipinas Corporation and Landers Superstore are giving motorists more ways to save and be rewarded as they officially launch their partnership, bringing together Shell’s high-quality fuels and trusted service with exclusive benefits for Landers and Shell Go+ members. item.description: Hyundai Motor Philippines Inc. (HMPH) is showcasing its vehicle lineup at the Hyundai Mobility Experience (HME), happening from October 8 to 11 at Festival Mall in Alabang. Read More »

item.title: Honda Has Just Produced Its 10-Millionth Motorcycle In The Philippines
item.description: Honda Philippines, Inc. (HPI), the leading motorcycle manufacturer in the country, enters another defining chapter as it celebrates the production of its 10-millionth motorcycle unit in a ceremony held at its manufacturing facility in Batangas. Read More »

item.title: GWM Philippines Hits All-Time Record Sales Last September
item.description: GWM Philippines closed September 2026 with 262 units sold, its highest monthly total since the brand’s launch. The result tops August’s 232 units, itself a record, and brings YTD sales to 836 units. Continued strong demand for the Haval H7 drove the growth. Read More »

item.title: Lexus Extends Its Ownership Offers This October As It Displays At Estancia And Powerplant Mall
item.description: This October, Lexus is heading to Estancia in Pasig City and Power Plant Mall in Rockwell, Makati this October 9 to 11, 2026. Read More »
